text:
matt: Quick Q — triaging a spike in 5xx for ACME on the EU gen route. Where's the saved search for org:acme model:gen-xl route:/v1/generate region:eu? Also want kv-cache miss numbers for the same window.

anya: There's an ops preset we usually use — ops/acme-eu-gen-5xx-kvmiss. Link on the team dashboard: https://console.redwood/observability/dashboards/ops-acme-eu :eyes:
If you don't see it, here's the log query I run: 

```
org:acme AND model:gen-xl AND route:"/v1/generate" AND region:eu AND status:[500 TO 599]
| stats count() by status, route, model
```

sophia: For KV cache miss rate I usually run this: 

```
route="/v1/generate" AND metric:kv_cache_miss AND org:acme AND region:eu
| timechart avg(kv_cache_miss) by model
```

matt: Thanks — can someone save that as the preset name ops/acme-eu-gen-5x-kvmiss (or ops/acme-eu-gen-5xx-kvmiss)? Also need an alert tweak: current 5xx alert is noisy during deploys. Suggest: trigger if p95 >= 2.0 for 3m, but suppress for canary flagged deploys.

anya: +1, I can add a suppression rule. Add this filter to the alert definition to ignore canary traffic: 

```
NOT tags:canary AND org:acme AND model:gen-xl
```

alerts-bot: Alert rule "ACME EU gen 5xx" updated by anya — suppression rule added. :white_check_mark:

sophia: I pushed a quick dashboard panel to the team ops dashboard (panel id: acme-eu-gen) — preview: https://console.redwood/observability/dashboards/team-ops?panel=acme-eu-gen

matt: Awesome. If someone can paste the exact saved-search link here I can pin it in the oncall runbook. :thumbsup:

anya: Saved and linked: https://console.redwood/logs/saved/ops/acme-eu-gen-5xx-kvmiss. Also opened a tiny PR that updates the alert rule with the canary suppression (PR: https://github.com/redwood/ops-config/pull/142).

matt: Closing the loop — will watch the next deploy and re-evaluate thresholds if it still flaps. Thanks all!
